name: University of Tübingen Zentrum für Datenverarbeitung (ZDV)
notes: University page identifies ZDV as the university computing/data center serving students, faculties and central institutions at Wächterstraße 76, Tübingen. No new commercial/hyperscale DC evidence found in method search; CustomColo Tübingen landing page markets facilities in Hamburg/Berlin/Frankfurt/Düsseldorf/Amsterdam/Copenhagen, not a local Tübingen DC.

name: Dr.-Ing. Nepustil & Co. GmbH Rechenzentrum Tübingen
notes: Operator imprint lists Rechenzentrum Tübingen at Brückenstraße 7, 72074 Tübingen; project page references remote-backup tape-library housing in the Tübingen data center.

name: SWU Rechenzentrum II, Ulm Science Park III
developer: Stadtwerke Ulm/Neu-Ulm GmbH / SWU TeleNet; built by DC-Datacenter-Group
notes: City of Ulm reported symbolic key handover 2025-03-27 after ~2 years construction; donau3fm confirms opening. DCD: 1,430 sqm, PUE below 1.3, 1.6 MW backup generation; SWU said space for ~150 server cabinets. No additional new Ulm DC projects surfaced in method search.
Method searches for Landkreis Waldshut / Waldshut-Tiengen + Rechenzentrum/Datacenter/data center returned only generic industry pages and no district-specific project or facility evidence.

name: weber.cloud Data Center Balingen 1
notes: Operator page states weber.cloud owns/operates its own DC in the same building as its Balingen HQ (Zollernalbkreis); PeeringDB lists Balingen facility at Bahnhofstr. 16. Zollernalbkreis geoportal (zollernalbkreis.de/geoportal-zak) provides Bebauungsplan layers; no new B-Plan DC project found.

name: weber.cloud Data Center Balingen 2 (BL2)
notes: Operator page mentioned a second weber.cloud DC in Balingen (BL2); Data Center Map also notes a second facility being built at Zollernstr. 47-49, Balingen.

name: za-internet Datacenter Hechingen
notes: Operator page states za-internet operates a provider-independent datacenter in Hechingen with customer rack space and multiple upstream providers.

name: GBC local data center Balingen/Albstadt
notes: Company page says GBC has operated critical systems since 1987 with its own local data center in Balingen/Albstadt for SMEs and public-sector institutions.

name: Aichach-Friedberg district school data center
notes: Regional press described a data center for district schools; Realschule Mering and Gymnasium Friedberg still to be migrated by mid-2026. No commercial/hyperscale DC found in method search for the district.
Searches for Altötting/Burghausen + Rechenzentrum/Datacenter/data center found no dedicated facility or project (only generic industry pages).

name: OTH Amberg-Weiden Rechenzentrum, Amberg campus
notes: University page identifies the OTH Amberg-Weiden computing center as IT service provider and IT competence center for university operations. Note: a separate 'Amberg' (Unterallgäu) AI DC by Polarise exists but is in Landkreis Unterallgäu, not this Amberg (Oberpfalz) division.
Searches for Landkreis Amberg-Sulzbach + Rechenzentrum/Datacenter found no district-specific project or facility evidence.

name: Dietenhofen Playmobil-site data center redevelopment proposal
notes: Regional reports say an investor wants to build a data center east of Neustädter Straße on the former Playmobil complex in Dietenhofen (plant closure confirmed by BR24), planning/permitting begun; capacity not disclosed. Intent-level project; no Bauantrag evidence found in this round.

name: Bezirk Mittelfranken interim data center, Ansbach
notes: 2020 regional report: Liegenschaftsausschuss to consider an interim data center at the Ansbach district administration site (outdoor IT container) because the Danziger Straße 7 DC reached capacity. Status unverified since; no new evidence in method search.

name: NewTelco MainRZ Karlstein
notes: NewTelco describes MainRZ in Karlstein am Main (Landkreis Aschaffenburg) with redundant power from two independent sources at 5 MW; DCD reported opening Nov 30, 2023 with 5 MW IT capacity.

name: PASS Cloud One
notes: PASS says its existing Cloud One DC is at the Aschaffenburg HQ, part of a metrocluster with Cloud One-Two and Cloud One-Two-Three.

name: PASS Cloud One-Two
notes: PASS announced completion of the energy-efficient Cloud One-Two DC at its Cloud Computing & Service Center in Hanauer Straße, Aschaffenburg, supplementing Cloud One.

name: LEW Green Data Center (Neusäß site)
notes: LEW announced the colocation facility entered operation May 26, 2025; four modules, 1,900 sqm, up to 600 racks; Goldbeck project reference reports 1.8 MW IT load; public listings place it at Oskar-von-Miller-Straße 1B, 86356 Neusäß (Landkreis Augsburg).

name: M-Net Augsburg RZ Steinerne Furt
notes: Eco DC audit identifies RZ Steinerne Furt in Augsburg; M-net ISO 27001 certificate annex lists Rechenzentrum Steinerne Furt 65, 86167 Augsburg for high-availability data-center infrastructure.

name: M-Net Augsburg / Curt-Frenzel-Strasse site
notes: M-net 2025 ISO 27001 certificate annex includes Curt-Frenzel-Straße 4, 86167 Augsburg under the certified scope; Inflect lists an M-Net Augsburg colocation facility with a differing Johannes-Haag-Straße address, so capacity and exact site identity left null.

name: LEW Green Data Center (Augsburg-Oberhausen, Krumbacher Straße)
notes: Augsburger Allgemeine (2025-01-01/02): LEW TelNet building a €30M green colocation data center ('LEW Green Data Center') at Krumbacher Straße, Augsburg-Oberhausen, 1,900 sqm / up to 600 racks, 'first green colocation RZ in the region' from early 2025; building largely finished by Jan 2025. LOCATION AMBIGUOUS: LEW/Goldbeck official material places the LEW Green Data Center in Neusäß (Landkreis Augsburg) - this Oberhausen-reported site may be the same campus or a second LEW facility; recorded separately per Augsburger Allgemeine with C grade until confirmed.

name: Landratsamt Bad Kissingen data center modernization
developer: Landratsamt Bad Kissingen / SVA System Vertrieb Alexander GmbH
notes: SVA case study: district office consolidated its historically grown data center using Dell VxRail stretched-cluster; Kommune21 reported the modernization Sept 14, 2022.

name: Intelsat Kommunications Bad-Kissingen (Fuchsstadt)
notes: Datacenterplatform lists an Intelsat Germany DC at Sandflur 1, Fuchsstadt, 97727 (Landkreis Bad Kissingen); spelling appears as 'Kommuunikations' in listing; no capacity disclosed.

name: Bundeswehr Rechenzentrum Wildflecken
notes: Bundeswehr planned a southern-Germany IT center; Wildflecken was in the site review (infranken 2017-12-06: Rhönallianz/all MPs backed Wildflecken, planning 'at the beginning'); district 2021 release said construction handled by state building offices; Dec 2023 local press reported the Wildflecken DC might be canceled. Current status unknown - preserved as negative/pending evidence.
Searches for Bad Tölz / Wolfratshausen / Geretsried + Rechenzentrum/Datacenter found no dedicated facility or project evidence.

name: centron Datacenter Hallstadt
notes: Centron operates its ISO 27001 DC at Heganger 29, Hallstadt (Landkreis Bamberg); opened 2014 (operations since 2008); Data Center Map lists 1 MW / prior record 1.25 MW. Firmenpresse 2025-10-09 incident notice confirms Hallstadt DC still operating (NSHV/USV fault, no impact). 2020 firmenpresse notes centron DCs in Nürnberg, Coburg, Frankfurt, Hallstadt - no new Bamberg-region build found.

name: Stadtnetz Bamberg datacenter
notes: Inflect lists a Stadtnetz Bamberg DC at 28 Margaretendamm, 96052 Bamberg, with colocation and internet access services; capacity not disclosed.

name: T-Systems Bamberg
notes: Baxtel lists T-Systems Bamberg at Gutenbergstrasse 13 as fully operational; capacity not publicly disclosed.
No datacenter project or facility evidence found for Landkreis Bayreuth (rural) in first-round or method searches.

name: TMT Data Center Bayreuth
notes: TMT says it operates its own data centers and offers colocation, managed hosting, private cloud and DC solutions from Bayreuth; ISO 27001:2022 scope covers operation of IT, cloud, data-center and communications solutions.

name: University of Bayreuth data center
notes: Datacenterplatform lists a University of Bayreuth DC at Universitaetsstrasse 30, 95447 Bayreuth; university documents reference servers in colocation cabinets; no public capacity found.
